content:
name: Change Request / RFC
about: Propose a controlled change to an accepted baseline or architecture.
title: "[Change] "
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: pressure
    attributes:
      label: Change pressure
      description: Why does the accepted baseline need reconsideration?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: authority
    attributes:
      label: Affected authority
      description: List affected ADRs, specifications, product contracts, or EOS policies.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: proposal
    attributes:
      label: Proposed change
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: impact
    attributes:
      label: Impact, migration, and risk
    validations:
      required: true
